content.short: BitDAO is a token-governed treasury that uses its funds to empower generations of Web3 builders.
content.description: BitDAO aims to level the playing field by building a decentralized token economy governed by BIT token holders. As one of the world's newest and largest DeFi-focused DAOs, it seeks to attract developer talent through token swaps and co-development efforts. These swaps enable the BitDAO treasury to accumulate valuable crypto project tokens. The DAO envisions open finance and a decentralized tokenized economy, supporting projects across DeFi, DAOs, NFTs, and gaming, with research and development, liquidity bootstrapping, and funding always provided.
